text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, October 29, 2018 Posted by admin on October 29th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +136 points.
Friday the Dow was down -296.24 (-1.19%) at 24,688.31.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -0.13%.
There were 4 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Intel (INTC) +3.11%, Walgreens (WBA) +0.65% and Merck (MRK) +0.63%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Home Depot (HD) -3.82%, Cisco (CSCO) -2.68% and UnitedHealth (UNH) -2.29%.
Apple (AAPL -1.59%) was rated a new ‘Buy’ at Jeffries with a price target of $265.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down four-tenths of a cent at $2.818 per gallon.
